title: Friday Night Magic 2007: card flavor text

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A group whose vault holds the Mirari, which radiates darkness across Otaria.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: A powerful object that pulsed like a dead sun in the Cabal's vault, spreading its darkness across Otaria.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A land across which the Mirari's darkness radiated.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Authors of progress notes on a viral brew, the Engineered Plague.

entities.name: Scroll of Beginnings
entities.description: An in-world writing that tells of Wonder and the awestruck birds.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A figure whose verdict is the subject of a card; the flavor says a heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

events.summary: The Mirari pulses in the Cabal's vault, its darkness radiating across Otaria.
events.quote: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun-and its darkness radiated across Otaria.
